sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 4891 of 2023

Applicant :- Smt. Asha
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- M.C. Singh,Dushyant Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material placed on record.

This anticipatory bail application (under section 438 Cr.P.C.) has been moved seeking bail in Case Crime No.359 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 304B I.P.C. & Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Aurangabad, District Bulandshahr.
It is submitted that in this case applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased who was wedded to her son Gulu @ Ved Prakash.
Further submitted that applicant is innocent and has falsely been named in the F.I.R. being sas of the deceased.

It is further submitted that there was mutual dispute between husband and wife that was the reason deceased was in her maika since 04.12.2021 and committed Smt. Asha vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98530733/
1 suicide on 09.12.2022 after one year in her father's house.

entities.text: Smt. Asha vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: During post-mortem no any injury was found on her person and cause of death could not be ascertained but viscera was preserved.
It is further submitted that applicant is aged about 73 years and suffering from physical ailments.
Since investigation is going on and the applicant is under apprehension of imminent arrest.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, she would not misuse the liberty of bail and would cooperate with the investigation.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A., perusal of record, the fact of deceased living in her maika for a period of one year and committing suicide there and without making any comment on the merit of the case, the applicant is entitled to be released on anticipatory bail in this case for the limited period considering the exception considered by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC Online SC 98.

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC Online SC 98
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In default of any of the conditions, the Investigating Officer is at liberty to file appropriate application for cancellation of anticipatory bail granted to the applicant.
